reponse: No salary has been offered to Yael Mizrahi yet. She was still in the hiring process as of November 17, 2026, having advanced to a final round interview with Maya Cohen scheduled for November 24 [1][3]. The team agreed to wait until after the final round before discussing numbers with her [4], and Slack guidance said no offer discussions with candidates until after the final [3]. Yael hasn't given a salary figure, only that she expects something "competitive with big tech" [4]. For reference, the L5 Senior SRE band is 520–600k ILS base in Tel Aviv or $170–190k in New York [2].
